[b]In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

From the office derived from His Authority,

In the name of all Irocco, the Iroccoans, the Sybic, and the Maiqah,

Written by the hands of Sealiph, Ibrahim ibn Gakh'ud Al Iyaiid,[/b]

[i][u]As-salamu alaykum[/u][/i]

"The madness of minds corrupted by beliefs false and made by Iblis to ensnare the power-hungry and desperate into his trap is evident within the claims of the Supreme Final Catgirl State, they show a distorted view of the history of the Dunya. This nation has failed the Test of the Almighty and pursues a self-serving, fervent ideology which seeks mastery over this World of Mirrors. They proclaim the desire to become the sole Hegemon of the World, this Dar al-Niku seeks to make its house the house of the world. But this endeavour is doomed to fail, all things are when Allah is not at the forefront of their minds. These Niku worship strange gods, stranger than even their corrupted appearance-

-The Sealiphate of Irocco denies the attempts of the unfaithful empire to subject Irocco to tyranny, like the Sybu once have. We proclaim ourselves as the eternal enemies of the Supreme Final Catgirl State, and once more proclaim ourselves as Slaves of God, subject to the destiny to fight against His enemies, the infidel and the heretic. We rebuke you, Slaves of the Enemy of God, and plead you to return to Him before, like the Khan of Khans of the Eternal Blue Sky, are turned to ash and folded into bones by His will and our arms. We will forevermore undertake a hostile reactionary stance against your hellish regime."

[b]Peace be upon those who follow His guidance,

Sealiph,
Ibrahim ibn Gakh'ud Al Iyaiid[/b]
